name: Botan
source:
She'll take good care of you♫
From meals to bed-making, she's the big sister who knows everything!

The corgi from his parents' place who's staying over at the protagonist's house. She's a slightly horny older sister-type who loves physical contact. She will take care of anything you need, but...she will try to take care of even the "other" things as well. 
In actuality, she had been around since the protagonist was in preschool. "Had" being the operative word, because in the world he came from, she died of old age around the time he graduated high school. In this world, dogs live long lives, so she is apparently still living happily and in good health.
Since she grew up alongside the protagonist as a puppy in his preschool days, she tends to think of herself as a human. Because of that, when she seeks physical affection from him, it's less as a dog and more as a human. That makes things awkward for the protagonist, but she knows that and does it anyway.

"Why am I licking you, you ask? It's natural for a dog to lick their master, isn't it?"
